description: This file defines the ProductDescription entity class, representing localized descriptions for products in the database. It includes fields such as id, product, languageId, name, description, friendlyUrl, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: ProductDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing localized product descriptions, linked to Product via a many-to-one relationship, with fields for id, product, languageId, name, description, friendlyUrl, createdAt, and updatedAt.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the UUID identifier of the product description.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the UUID identifier of the product description.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the Product entity associated with this description.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product entity with this description.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the language for this description.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the UUID for the language of the description.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product in this description.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product in this description.

methods.name: getFriendlyUrl
methods.description: Returns the friendly URL associated with this description.
